summary: Apple's framework is one extension point: a notification content app extension (UNNotificationContentExtension) that supplies the view for a notification, with custom action handling and media play/pause controls. BifrOSt has no app-supplied notification view; its shell draws banner, lock-screen and Notification Center cards itself, and apps get delivery, categories and responses through the usernotif SDK.

features.feature: Notification content app extension (custom notification view)
features.apple: UNNotificationContentExtension, didReceive(_:), Customizing the Appearance of Notifications
features.note: the shell draws every notification card; no app can supply a view controller or view for a delivered notification
category actions (button, destructive, foreground, text reply) and Response events exist; no content-extension response options or per-view action dismissal

features.feature: Media play and pause in notifications
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 2 (user-notifications-ui, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no media button API on notification cards; the Music and Podcasts apps have their own playback controls but not in notifications round 75, host only: SDK path; shell does not draw the button yet.

features.feature: Delivering notifications to the notification UI
features.apple: UNNotificationContent delivery into the system banner, lock screen and Notification Center (framework context)
features.note: banner, lock screen stack and Notification Center exist; subtitle and body are shown but there is no sound, attachment or userInfo

gaps: App-supplied notification view (UNNotificationContentExtension) with a view controller that renders delivered content
Media play and pause controls on a notification (mediaPlayPauseButton* and mediaPlay()/mediaPause())
Content-extension response options (UNNotificationContentExtensionResponseOption) and dismissal behaviour per action
Notification attachments and userInfo payloads for custom content (noted in docs/bifrost-ui.md, User notifications section)
